race.comment: AND THERE YOU GO (6) is off a let-up here having been highly competitive in a pair of stakes races in Adelaide at her past two starts. Only beaten three lengths by a potential star in Pretty Baby two back before placing in a G3 last time out, this suits nicely. SUPERBEC (12) ran well on speed at Sandown Hillside over 1000m last time out when just shaded. Up to 1200m a slight niggle but will give a sight. SEALAND (3) made nice improvement second up at Sale and warrants respect with Lane on. MISS GRAFF (9) chased Natural Fling on debut back in May when fourth at Caulfield over 1100m and is worth keeping an eye on.
